capabilities: display the active note's token count in the status bar
recalculate tokens as the note is edited with a 150 ms debounce
switch between exact GPT-4o/GPT-5 and approximate Claude tokenizer modes
estimate Claude token counts locally using cl100k_base plus a +15% margin
disambiguation: It only counts tokens locally; it does not call any AI service or send notes anywhere.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; Claude token counts are approximations because Anthropic publishes no offline tokenizer.
problem: Obsidian's word count does not tell you how many LLM tokens a note uses when budgeting a context window.

relations.evidence: It uses the js-tiktoken library, JavaScript port of OpenAI's tiktoken

summary: Status bar plugin that shows the live token count of the active note using TikToken's o200k_base encoding for GPT-4o/GPT-5.
